mentions.name: JARVIS
mentions.description: A personal life-management assistant that integrates with Google Mail, Google Calendar, Trello, GroupMe, and EveryDollar. It nags the user to do grown-up tasks and answers questions through a conversational interface, offering a better UX than Google Calendar or Trello.
mentions.problem: Calendar and task tools like Google Calendar and Trello have confusing UX for managing personal tasks.
mentions.audience: The author's own personal life management
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm tinkering around building "JARVIS" (I didn't want to come up with a clever self deprecating name - this works) - a personal project to manage my life. Integrates into Google Mail, Google Calendar, Trello, GroupMe, EveryDollar. Basically it nags me to do grown up thing and is a better UX than Google Calendar/Trello - I just talk to it and ask it things.
